name: Dust of days
original_name: ダスト・オブ・デイズ
source:
A colossal ‘city’ stretches to the edge of the horizon. 
And every day, people are just surviving.
Deep underground, subway lines weave through all kinds of spaces. 
In that darkness, voices echo. 
Are those the cries of people forgotten by the city, now turned to 'nothingness'? 
Or whispers from residents who keep communicating each night through a network?
In a corner of this city, where folks shiver by day and burn with fever in the night's gloom, 
each meaningless day stretches on endlessly.

[Translated from [url=https://whiteophidion.sakuraweb.com/software/dust/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
一座巨大的“城市”延伸到地平线的边缘。
每一天，人们都在生存。
地下深处，地铁线路蜿蜒穿过各种空间。
在那黑暗中，声音回响。
这些是被城市遗忘、变成“虚无”的人们的呼喊吗？
或者每晚通过网络不断交流的居民的窃窃私语？
在这个城市的一个角落里，人们白天瑟瑟发抖，夜晚阴暗时发烧，
每一个毫无意义的日子都无限地延伸着。

[翻译自[url=https://whiteophidion.sakuraweb.com/software/dust/]官网[/url]]
